item.title: 8 things to do in Las Vegas this Valentine's Day weekend
item.description: Are you still looking for Valentine's Day plans? 8 News Now has compiled a list of fun-filled events across the Las Vegas valley to enjoy with your special someone, friends or by yourself!

item.title: Former Las Vegas business owner faces prison time for not paying $1.2M in taxes
item.description: LAS VEGAS (KLAS) -- A former business owner pleaded guilty Thursday to not paying employment taxes on behalf of the cleaning company she owned, causing a tax loss to the government of $1.2 million, according to the U.S. Department of Justice. item.title: Infamous Wynn kidnapping riveted Las Vegas as trial revealed ransom from Mirage casino cage
item.description: When Steve Wynn's daughter, Kevyn, was kidnapped in 1993, the casino mogul carried stacks of $100 bills — $1.45 million in all — from The Mirage to pay her captors.

item.title: Man arrested for shooting, killing daughter's boyfriend in southwest Las Vegas
item.description: A man was taken into custody after shooting and killing his daughter's boyfriend in Las Vegas on Thursday morning.

item.title: Las Vegas shoppers react to charge for premium parking spots at South Valley outlet mall
item.description: Shoppers shared their reactions to a paid parking option recently added to the Las Vegas South Premium outlets.

item.title: Federal officials back Nevada OSHA in dropping fines against Boring Co.
item.description: Federal OSHA officials backed state OSHA officials' decision to drop more than $400,000 in fines against Elon Musk's The Boring Company after two Clark County firefighters received chemical burns inside a Vegas Loop tunnel in 2024.

item.title: Nevada DMV finding stolen, VIN swapped cars weekly
item.description: J.D. Decker, chief of Nevada’s DMV Compliance Enforcement Division, said VIN inspectors are catching swapped VINs twice a week.

item.title: Man shoots, kills roommate in east Las Vegas valley
item.description: A man shot and killed his roommate during an argument in an east valley apartment complex, Metro police said Thursday.

item.title: Henderson police union contracts finalized, sort of
item.description: Negotiations between the Henderson police unions and city hall have reached a conclusion after a yearlong battle over higher wages, and both sides are claiming some form of success.

item.title: Driver admits drug use before crash that killed teen, police say
item.description: An impaired driver accused of killing a 17-year old admitted to police that he had used meth in the hours before the crash, according to documents 8 News Now obtained.
